original_target.title: Deterministic pseudospectral shattering in nearly cubic time

scope_comparison: Requires a uniform deterministic almost-cubic algorithm producing a small perturbation with both eigenvector conditioning and minimumgap polynomially controlled. Random perturbations, Hermitian-only eigensolvers, diagonalization existence and implementation repositories do not supply that deterministic shattering theorem. No full matching claim found.
